verdict.rationale: The Nevada Secretary of State is a government filing authority and official business registry. Self-hosting its core product is a category error: the registry's legal authority cannot be replicated on a user's own infrastructure. The evidence covers only bot walls at robots.txt on nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov, and nothing suggests any self-hostable software is distributed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
